scope: Public MatrixGame2Pipeline Universal checkpoint, official snowy reference image, seed42, official_bench_actions=true, 15 requested latent frames yielding 57 RGB frames 640x352/12fps. Both official and WorldFoundry videos fully decoded. Three CPU action lengths matched official tensors exactly; after project RNG/seed repair, decoded RGB mean absolute difference improved from 54.890 to 4.762. Viewed all six paired contact positions from the actual decoded videos: the snowy hut, trees and mountain background remain coherent while the camera moves around the hut and returns; corresponding official and repaired WorldFoundry frames have nearly the same layout. Fine texture and color differ, so this is not bitwise parity. This validates the short configuration, not the 150-latent-frame default, benchmark score, closed-loop gameplay, or exact pixel equality.
